reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and threads it through all its callers, but the 'off day' test is written fresh at each site instead of one exported predicate.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday predicate appears three times (isOffDay in schedules/app.ts, isOff inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and the inline notWeekend in getNextDate), while the template's repeated adjust expression is consolidated into a local solveWeekend.

placement.why: Moving the date stays in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip predicate is defined privately in server/schedules/app.ts and again inline in shared code rather than next to the shared date helper.

scope.why: Focused on holidays; the solveWeekend extraction in schedule-template.ts is a small adjacent tidy-up needed to pass holidays without a third copy.

maintainability.why: Adding another kind of off day later would require editing three separate predicates that must stay identical.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All date moves go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; there was no shared off-day predicate before, so the copies are new duplication rather than a bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The weekend-or-holiday check is restated under three names: isOffDay (server/schedules/app.ts), isOff (getDateWithSkippedWeekend) and the reshaped notWeekend lambda in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts).

one_place.where: Moving an occurrence is decided once in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but which days count as off (for daily skipping) is decided separately in isOffDay (getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates) and inline in getNextDate.
